_tv_doc: TV face keys (item 5, Wi-Fi/security amendments 2026-09-13). SECURITY (amendment 6, 2026-09-13): this file is TRACKED in a PUBLIC repo -- tv_host/tv_mac/tv_name/tv_model/pc_lan_ips/station_url NEVER hold real values here. Those live ONLY in automation/state/station/tv.json (gitignored) and are overlaid onto this config AT RUNTIME by station_board.load_merged_station_config() (used by station_serve.py and station_tv.py); a missing/unreadable tv.json is a loud failure ('tv.json missing'), never a silent 0.0.0.0 bind or a guessed address. tv_hdmi_source/station_serve_port/dashboard_origin/kiosk_display_index are not identifying and stay real here. kiosk_display_index is 1-based into [System.Windows.Forms.Screen]::AllScreens; 2 = the TV as second monitor when HDMI is plugged in. Pairing token lives in .tv-token (gitignored, ACL-locked to the current user by station_tv.py --pair), never in this file.
_port_doc: 80, not 8420 (2026-09-13): the Tizen TV browser treats any URL carrying a port number as a Google search (Samsung community thread 7446509), so the face URL must be http://<pc-lan-ip>/station?kiosk=1 with no port. Port 80 was free on this PC (netstat); the server still binds the LAN IP only with the TV+PC allowlist.
_hdmi_kiosk_doc: SAFETY GATE found during verification 2026-09-13 (Sonnet builder #2): this box already reports 2 displays for J's own normal desk setup (DISPLAY2 is his live second monitor, confirmed by a real station_kiosk.ps1 -Snapshot capture -- not a TV). The '>=2 displays -> launch a fullscreen kiosk browser' path from the original spec would therefore hijack J's own active monitor the instant Gamma_StationKiosk fires, not just when a TV is genuinely HDMI-connected. hdmi_kiosk_enabled defaults false so station_kiosk.ps1 -Start ALWAYS falls through to the Wi-Fi TV face (station_tv.py --face) regardless of display count, until a human flips this to true after physically confirming the TV is the actual HDMI-connected display (and updating kiosk_display_index to match it, not just trusting the count).
